entries.title: Psalms 86:1
segments: ¶<<A Prayer of David.>> Incline thine ear, Jehovah, answer me; for I am afflicted and needy.

entries.title: Psalms 86:2
segments: Keep my soul, for I am godly; O thou my God, save thy servant who confideth in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 86:3
segments: Be gracious unto me, O Lord; for unto thee do I call all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 86:4
segments: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; for unto thee, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 86:5
segments: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, and art of great loving-kindness unto all that call upon thee.

entries.title: Psalms 86:6
segments: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer, and attend to the voice of my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 86:7
segments: In the day of my distress I will call upon thee, for thou wilt answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 86:8
segments: ¶Among the gods there is none like unto thee, Lord, and there is nothing like unto thy works.

entries.title: Psalms 86:9
segments: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord, and shall glorify thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:10
segments: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God, thou alone.

entries.title: Psalms 86:11
segments: Teach me thy way, Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:12
segments: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 86:13
segments: For great is thy loving-kindness toward me, and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

entries.title: Psalms 86:14
segments: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assembly of the violent seek after my soul, and they have not set thee before them.

entries.title: Psalms 86:15
segments: But thou, Lord, art a *God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in goodness and truth.

entries.title: Psalms 86:16
segments: Turn toward me, and be gracious unto me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

entries.title: Psalms 86:17
segments: Shew me a token for good, that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed; for thou, Jehovah, hast helped me and comforted me.
